description: This file manages plugin signature verification, public key retrieval, addition, and deletion within the Mattermost server, including signature verification using OpenPGP and handling SAML-related files.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application struct with methods for managing public keys.

classes.name: Server
classes.description: Server struct with method to retrieve public keys from config files.

classes.name: Channels
classes.description: Channels struct with method to verify plugin signatures.

methods.name: GetPublicKey
methods.description: Retrieves the public key file content by name.

methods.name: AddPublicKey
methods.description: Adds or updates a plugin public key file.

methods.name: DeletePublicKey
methods.description: Deletes a plugin public key file.

methods.name: verifyPlugin
methods.description: Verifies plugin signature using hard-coded or configured public keys.

methods.name: verifySignature
methods.description: Verifies a signature against a public key and message.

methods.name: verifyBinarySignature
methods.description: Checks a detached signature using OpenPGP.

methods.name: decodeIfArmored
methods.description: Decodes an armored or raw public key or signature.

methods.name: isSamlFile
methods.description: Checks if a filename is a SAML-related file.
